Our Ecosystem

Complete EV Charging Ecosystem

From ultra-fast highway charging to fleet management, smart payments, and AI-powered route planning.

Ultra-Fast Charging

480kW dynamic power dispensers with CCS2, Bharat DC001, and Type 2 connectors for all EV models.

CCS2 Type 2

Smart Route Planner

AI-powered trip planner that suggests optimal charging stops based on your battery, route, and real-time availability.

One-Tap Charging

UPI, cards, wallets, RFID, and app-based charging with automatic billing, GST invoices, and session history.

Fleet Command Center

Dedicated dashboard for electric buses, taxis, logistics with bulk booking, priority access, and analytics.

Powered by Statiq CPMS

Statiq.in Integration

Our network is powered by Statiq's industry-leading Charge Point Management System (CPMS). This means real-time availability, remote diagnostics, dynamic pricing, and seamless interoperability with 50+ charging networks across India.

Real-Time Monitoring

Live charger status, power output, and fault detection with instant alerts to operations team.

Roaming Network

Access 10,000+ chargers across India through Statiq's interoperable roaming network.

Dynamic Pricing

Smart pricing based on demand, time-of-day, and grid load to optimize your charging costs.

Statiq App Compatible

Use Statiq app or WattSquare app to find, book, and pay for charging seamlessly.

Project Overview

Building South India's Largest Ultra-Fast Charging Corridor

WattSquare ChargeHub LLP is establishing a scalable network of ultra-fast EV charging stations across key highway corridors in Andhra Pradesh and Telangana. Each station is designed with 480 kW capacity to support intercity buses, fleet operators, and private EV users.
